item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Confidential VMs with OS Disk Encryption support on AKS
item.description:
Azure AKS confidential VM node pools now support OS disk encryption in public preview. This closes the at-rest gap for regulated customers by adding platform support for encrypting the OS disk on Ubuntu 26.04 confidential VM node pools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential VMs with Intel TDX support on AKS
item.description:
AKS Confidential VM node pools now support Intel TDX in generally available state. This addresses the previous limitation where CVM node images only supported AMD SEV-SNP, preventing Intel TDX workloads from running on AKS.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Azure confidential VMs on 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors (DCasv7 and ECasv7 series)
item.description:
Azure has put its next-generation confidential VM series into private preview. The DCasv7, DCadsv7, DCalsv7, DCaldsv7, ECasv7, and ECadsv7 series run on 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with AMD SEV-SNP to protect data in use.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential VMs for Azure Linux
item.description:
Confidential Virtual Machines for Azure Linux in AKS are now generally available. This adds CVM node pool support for migrating highly sensitive container workloads to AKS.

  • Source: Azure Updates
